capabilities: Render tables with MultiMarkdown 6 syntax via -tx- blocks or experimental native syntax
Merge cells across columns and rows
Write multiline cells and multiple table headers
Add table captions and omit table headers
Keep internal links and embeds working inside tables
extras: Not compatible with Advanced Tables, whose auto-formatting breaks the mmd6 table syntax; behavior may differ from the official MultiMarkdown compiler. Requires Obsidian v0.12.0+; more usage details are in the markdown-it-multimd-table README and MultiMarkdown User's Guide.
intentEvidence: Extend basic table in Obsidian with MultiMarkdown table syntax.
problem: Obsidian's built-in table syntax only supports basics, so complex tables with colspan or multiple headers force users into hard-to-read raw HTML.
summary: Renders extended Markdown tables using MultiMarkdown 6 syntax, adding cell spans, multiline cells, multiple headers, captions and headerless tables.
